title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, upgrade actions, and repo hygiene
author: Avery Collins
description: Overview: Consolidates multiple GitHub Actions workflows (lint/test/release) into a smaller set of reusable workflows, upgrades core actions to latest stable versions, and performs repository hygiene (remove deprecated job definitions, standardize node versions in workflow matrix). Motivation: reduce maintenance overhead, improve cache hit rates across repos, and prepare the repo for node20 standardization. Changes include: 1) New workflows: .github/workflows/ci.yml (combines lint+unit+integration), .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation with improved tag validation), .github/workflows/codeql.yml (updated code scanning integration). 2) Action upgrades: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4, peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3. 3) Node matrix cleanup: canonicalized node versions (18, 20) and removed ad-hoc per-package overrides. 4) CI hygiene: consolidated caching key patterns to improve reuse, removed legacy docker build step that duplicated image pushes, standardized environment variable names used in workflows. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows - [x] Upgrade action versions - [x] Run full CI across monorepo - [x] Validate release tagging automation - [x] Update docs/CI.md snippets Context and testing: Ran full suite on branch (unit + integration + e2e smoke). CodeQL scan ran and showed no new high severity findings. Small follow-up patches expected to tune cache keys for platform-specific jobs. Links: Linear: ENG-2143, ENG-2147; Related: pr-67283-refactor-ci-consolidate-workflows-bump-actions (prior attempt), pr-50321 (release automation improvements).
commits: 3 commits:  - squash: consolidate ci workflows and upgrade actions  - fix: adjust matrix for node20 compatibility + cache keys  - chore: remove legacy docker push job
review_comments: Jordan Patel: Left a couple of inline suggestions on cache key normalization - prefer including OS and node major to avoid collisions.
Avery Collins: Updated cache keys and added comment explaining rationale; also removed legacy docker step per suggestion.
Maya Singh: Approve after minor docs tweak - asked to add a note about node20 rollout schedule in docs/CI.md.
Diego Ramirez: Noted that some SDK packages still use package-level GH actions; filed follow-up ENG-2199 to migrate those.
release_notes: Consolidated and upgraded CI workflows, standardized Node matrix (18,20), improved caching and release automation. No behavioral changes to product code. Follow-up: tweak cache keys for platform-specific jobs and migrate package-level workflows (ENG-2199).
